d:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down, after The Wall Street Journal reported it is preparing to oust him and The New York Times revealed a second extramarital relationship, this time with an Nvidia executive who reports to him.
It follows reports that Huang grew close to a woman U.S. intelligence has identified as a Chinese spy.
Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and never named a successor. So who could replace him, and what would a change at the top mean for the company at the center of the AI boom?
